name: What steps are involved in a professional bathtub replacement?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in a professional bathtub replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing an existing bathtub typically involves demoing the old tub, inspecting the subfloor and surrounding framing, updating rough-in plumbing, setting the new tub, and finishing the surrounding walls with waterproof backer board and custom tile or panels. If the replacement is part of a larger bathroom remodel, craftsmen may also update nearby vanities, flooring, and electrical fixtures. The entire sequence requires careful coordination between plumbing rough-ins and wall finishes to ensure a watertight installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathtub replacement involves removing the old unit, checking subfloors, updating plumbing rough-ins, setting the new tub, and installing waterproof wall surrounds and fixtures.
